capabilities.reason: EMR 6.5+ bundles an Iceberg runtime for Spark; earlier releases need a custom connector.
limitations: Iceberg tables on EMR honor LF only when the cluster runs an LF-integrated security configuration.

capabilities.reason: EMR 6.9+ ships a Delta Lake runtime for Spark; features depend on the bundled Delta version.
limitations: Delta on EMR uses the bundled connector; open-source delta-io versions differ.
Deletion vectors and liquid clustering depend on the Delta version bundled per release.

capabilities.reason: EMR on EC2 integrates with Lake Formation for Spark/EMRFS reads from release 5.32, gated on a security configuration.
limitations: Requires a security configuration enabling the Lake Formation integration.
EMR Serverless and EMR on EKS have their own LF support matrices.

capabilities.reason: EMR Serverless (Spark/Hive) is available from release emr-6.6; jobs run without cluster provisioning.
limitations: Per-job capacity caps are required for predictable cost.
